bibl.title: Jewish Elements in the Cologne Mani Codex.
bibl.seg: Johannes van Oort, Jewish Elements in the Cologne Mani Codex.
Journal of Early Christian History 9 (2019) pp. 85-96.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Jewish and Jewish-Christian Elements in the Cologne Mani Codex: a. "His Body" and the Section Headings; - b. "The Way" and "the Law"; - c. "The Rest"; - d. Mani's "Immortal" Gospel to Be Written Down; - e. Mani and the Ma'aseh Bereshit; - f. The Guardian Angel and the Angels' Conduct; - g. Animated Matter Speaking; - h. The Column of Glory; - i. Some Other Elements. - Conclusion.
